renderNoteId.label: Render Note
renderNoteId.description: An existing note to turn into a second view of the workout manager. Selecting it converts that note into a render note pointing at the widget; clearing it reverts the previously-chosen note to a text note.

weightUnit.label: Weight Unit
weightUnit.description: Label shown beside every weight. Recorded numbers are never converted, so switching this relabels existing data rather than recalculating it.

distanceUnit.label: Distance Unit
distanceUnit.description: Label shown beside every cardio distance. Recorded numbers are never converted.

defaultRest.label: Default Rest (seconds)
defaultRest.description: Rest seeded into a new session entry. Each entry can still be given its own.

restSound.label: Rest Timer Chime
restSound.description: Play a short chime when a rest timer runs out. The on-screen message is shown either way.

weeklyTarget.label: Workouts Per Week
weeklyTarget.description: How many workouts a week the Stats tab measures each week against.
